name: win-loss-review
description: Explain why a closed monday CRM deal was won or lost. Reads the deal's stage history, Emails & Activities timeline, notes and column changes, compares it with other closed deals on the same board, and writes a short evidence-based review. Use when someone asks "why did we win/lose Acme", "win-loss review for this deal", "closed-lost analysis", "what was the loss reason really", "what went wrong with this deal", "post-mortem on this opportunity" or "what can we learn from this closed deal". Works on one closed deal at a time. Not for open deals (offer daily-briefing on the board instead).
